title: 90 lbs (40 kg) armwrestling style preacher curls for 3
summary: This was fun; realistically this weight cannot be utilized for sets of 4 so I will be lowering it down to 85 lbs. For these armwrestling style preacher curls what matters is the stretch; if the weight becomes so heavy that you cannot fight the negative anymore then it needs to be lower. Sensation over sensational.
